name: knos_oidc_v2
docs: OIDC on Solana, second deployment: verifies an RS256 token from GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or any other RS256 issuer on chain.
A signing key is one of GitHub's four keys of 2 Oct 2026 or is named by GitHub's own signature; a key admitted that way waits a day and the
guardian's approval, every key expires 30 days after it was last attested, and the guardian can revoke a key for ever.
The guardian (a multisig vault) can approve and revoke. It cannot add a key, change a delay or an expiry, or touch a token account.
Upgradeable only through a multisig with a public 48-hour delay, until an outside review.
A native program: this file is written by hand from programs-v2/knos_oidc/src/lib.rs and checked by tests/test_idl.py.
Instruction data is the discriminant byte, then the arguments in order, little-endian, with no padding.
An argument or field of type bytes is raw and runs to the end: it has no length prefix.
Write, Step, Close, KeyParams and the Token account are the first deployment's (idl/knos_oidc.json), byte for byte.

instructions.name: Write
docs: Writes the token (the compact JWT) into the token account, created on first use and sized for `total` bytes (at most 8192).
Chunks may be sent in any order, several per transaction.

accounts.name: payer
accounts.desc: Pays the rent; only this account can write, step or close the token

instructions.name: Step
docs: Computes s^65537 mod n a few squarings at a time. The call that finishes the 16 squarings checks the PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256 encoding,
that alg is RS256 and that iss is the key's issuer (for a key of issuer 2: that sha256(iss) is the hash the key carries), decodes the
payload in place and marks the account VERIFIED.
Every call refuses a key that is not usable now: not ready (68), revoked (78), neither a genesis key nor approved or before activeAt (76),
at or past expiresAt (77).
2048-bit keys: Step(8), Step(8). 4096-bit keys: Step(2), Step(3) three times, Step(4), Step(1): the finishing call also hashes and
decodes the whole token, so it is given one squaring only.

accounts.name: payer
accounts.desc: The payer that wrote the token

accounts.name: key
accounts.desc: A usable key account of this program: PDA ["key", [issuer], sha256(n)]

instructions.name: Close
docs: Closes the token account; the rent goes back to the payer.

accounts.name: payer
accounts.desc: The payer that wrote the token

instructions.name: RegisterKey
docs: Creates the key account of an issuer's RSA modulus. A modulus whose sha256 is a genesis constant of the binary (GitHub's four keys of
2 Oct 2026) needs nothing more: activeAt = now, expiresAt = now + 30 days, flags = genesis | approved.
Any other modulus needs `attest`: a VERIFIED GitHub token, at most an hour past its expiry, whose job_workflow_ref starts with the pinned
rotate workflow, whose job_workflow_sha is the pinned commit, whose runner_environment is github-hosted, whose repository_owner_id and
repository_id are the attester's, whose event_name is schedule or workflow_dispatch, and whose audience is
knos-oidc:key:<issuer>:<sha256(n) hex>; and `attestKey`, the key account that verified that token, usable now by Step's rule (68 if it is
another account, 76, 77 or 78 if it is not usable): an attestation is worth nothing from the second its key is revoked or expires.
Then activeAt = now + 1 day, expiresAt = activeAt + 30 days, flags = 0: the key verifies nothing
until the day has passed and the guardian has approved it. Anyone may send it.

accounts.name: attest
accounts.desc: A VERIFIED token account naming this key; left out for a genesis key

accounts.name: attestKey
accounts.desc: The key account that verified `attest` (the Token account's key field); it must be usable now. Left out for a genesis key

instructions.name: KeyParams
docs: The key's Montgomery constants, checked on chain; the key is ready after this. Anyone may send it.

instructions.name: Refresh
docs: The same attestation as RegisterKey's, with the key account that verified it, for a key that exists and is not revoked: expiresAt
becomes now + 30 days if that is later. It never moves an expiry earlier and changes nothing else. Anyone may send it.
attestKey may be `key` itself while it is usable; an expired key is refreshed by an attestation verified under another key that is not.
For Refresh only, the run may be anyone's: the pinned rotate workflow at the pinned commit on a github-hosted runner, started by hand
(event_name workflow_dispatch) in a repository owned by the person who started it (repository_owner_id == actor_id).

accounts.name: attest
accounts.desc: A VERIFIED token account naming this key

accounts.name: attestKey
accounts.desc: The key account that verified `attest` (the Token account's key field); it must be usable now

instructions.name: Approve
docs: Marks a key approved. Refused for a revoked key and for a private key. Changes no time: an attested key still waits for its activeAt.

accounts.name: guardian
accounts.desc: The guardian: a constant of the binary (a multisig vault)

instructions.name: Revoke
docs: Marks a key revoked, for ever: no instruction clears the mark, and the account stays, so the same modulus can never be registered
for that issuer again. The wallet that registered a private key may revoke that key in the guardian's place.

accounts.name: guardian
accounts.desc: The guardian: a constant of the binary (a multisig vault); or, for a private key, its registrant

instructions.name: RegisterIssuerKey
docs: Any RS256 issuer, named by its URL (its iss claim): https://, printable ASCII with no quote or backslash, at most 200 bytes.
Creates the key account ["ikey", sha256(url), sha256(n)] and, with the issuer's first key, the Issuer account that holds the URL.
The attestation is RegisterKey's (the attester's run of the pinned rotate workflow, never anyone's run) with the audience
knos-oidc:ikey:<sha256(url) hex>:<sha256(n) hex>, and attestKey is the key account that verified it, usable now.
The key has issuer 2 and its issuer's hash after r2; it waits a day and the guardian's approval, expires, is refreshed (Refresh, with
this audience) and revoked like any attested key. Step under it requires sha256(iss) to be that hash, marks the token account issuer 2
and writes the hash into it (the first 32 bytes of x): never GitHub's or GitLab's number.

accounts.name: attest
accounts.desc: A VERIFIED token account naming this issuer and this key

accounts.name: attestKey
accounts.desc: The key account that verified `attest` (the Token account's key field); it must be usable now

instructions.name: RegisterPrivateKey
docs: A private key: any wallet registers it, with no attestation, for an issuer no public runner can reach (a company's GitHub Enterprise
Server). Creates the key account ["pkey", registrant, sha256(url), sha256(n)] with issuer 3, flags = private (8), activeAt = now,
expiresAt = now + 30 days, and after R^2 the issuer's hash and the registrant's address. Sent again by the same wallet for the same key,
expiresAt becomes now + 30 days if that is later. The registrant or the guardian revokes it.
Nobody vouches for such a key. Step under it marks the token account issuer 3 and writes the registrant into it (bytes 32..64 of x);
RegisterKey, RegisterIssuerKey and Refresh take no attestation from it; Approve refuses it. A consumer must check for issuer 3 and accept
such a token only from a registrant it trusts for that purpose.

accounts.name: registrant
accounts.desc: The wallet whose word the key is; pays the rent

accounts.name: Token
docs: PDA ["tok", payer, id], id = sha256 of the compact JWT. 626 bytes, then the token.
stage: 0 writing, 1 stepping, 2 VERIFIED. issuer: 0 GitHub Actions, 1 GitLab CI. Once VERIFIED, the decoded claims (JSON) are the
payloadLen bytes at payloadOff, counted from the start of the account, and exp is the token's exp claim.
A consumer checks that the account's owner is this program, that stage is 2 and that the clock is under exp + 3600.
A VERIFIED account stays VERIFIED if its key is revoked or expires afterwards.
issuer 2: any other issuer, admitted by RegisterIssuerKey. Once such an account is VERIFIED, the first 32 bytes of x are sha256 of the
issuer's URL and the next 32 are zero. A consumer names the issuers it accepts, by number or by hash.
issuer 3: a PRIVATE key verified it (RegisterPrivateKey): the same hash, and the next 32 bytes are the wallet that registered the key.
Such a token is that wallet's word, not the issuer's: a consumer accepts it only from a registrant it trusts for that purpose.

accounts.name: Key
docs: PDA ["key", [issuer], sha256(n)], n = the RSA modulus, big-endian. 40 bytes, then n and R^2 mod n as little-endian u32 limbs
(limbs is 64 for a 2048-bit key, 128 for a 4096-bit key; 4 * limbs bytes each).
state: 0 created, 1 ready (after KeyParams); never 2, so a key account is never read as a VERIFIED token.
activeAt, expiresAt: Unix seconds; the key verifies from activeAt until just before expiresAt.
flags: 1 approved by the guardian, 2 revoked, 4 genesis, 8 private. A key is usable when state is 1, it is not revoked, it is a genesis
key, approved or private, and activeAt <= now < expiresAt.
A key of issuer 2 (any other issuer) is at PDA ["ikey", sha256(url), sha256(n)] and has 64 more bytes after R^2: sha256 of the
issuer's URL, then 32 zero bytes.
A private key (issuer 3, flag 8) is at PDA ["pkey", registrant, sha256(url), sha256(n)] with the same 64 bytes: the hash, then the registrant.

accounts.name: Issuer
docs: PDA ["iss", sha256(url)]: the URL of an issuer admitted by RegisterIssuerKey, as it stands in its tokens' iss claim.
state is 3: never a token's stage or a key's state. Created with the issuer's first key and never changed.

errors.name: Base64Url
errors.msg: Not unpadded base64url

errors.name: Json
errors.msg: The token is not three parts, or a part is not a JSON object

errors.name: DuplicateClaim
errors.msg: A claim appears twice, under any spelling of its name (a key is compared with its escapes decoded)

errors.name: Claim
errors.msg: A claim is missing or of the wrong type, or the token expires more than a day ahead

errors.name: Length
errors.msg: Token too long or chunk out of range

errors.name: SignatureLength
errors.msg: The signature is not as long as the modulus, or not below it

errors.name: KeyParams
errors.msg: The key or its Montgomery constants are wrong

errors.name: Accounts
errors.msg: A wrong account, or a missing signature

errors.name: Key
errors.msg: Not a key account of this program, not ready yet, or not the key the token started with

errors.name: Stage
errors.msg: The account is in the wrong stage for this instruction

errors.name: BadSignature
errors.msg: The signature does not verify

errors.name: Algorithm
errors.msg: alg is not RS256

errors.name: Issuer
errors.msg: Unknown issuer, or iss is not the key's issuer

errors.name: Untrusted
errors.msg: The key is not in genesis and there is no valid attestation

errors.name: Attestation
errors.msg: The attestation's claims do not name this key from the pinned rotate workflow run in the attester's repository

errors.name: AttestationExpired
errors.msg: The attestation is more than an hour past its expiry

errors.name: KeyNotActive
errors.msg: The key is not active yet: its day of waiting has not passed, or the guardian has not approved it

errors.name: KeyExpired
errors.msg: The key expired: nothing attested it for 30 days. Refresh it with a new attestation

errors.name: KeyRevoked
errors.msg: The guardian revoked this key; it cannot be used, approved or refreshed again

errors.name: NotGuardian
errors.msg: Only the guardian can do this, and it must sign
